actions: Read UPSTREAM_PATTERNS in scripts/validation/check_skill_md_portability.py: it covers .agents/, .claude/lib/, and .claude/review-axes/
Checked each for a vendor-portability marker: 10 declared, 3 not (autoplan, negotiation, security-review)
Ran the validator: 'No Markdown vendor-portability drift. 0 grandfathered refs across 0 files (baseline 0)', so the ratchet is at its tightest and this path family is invisible to it
workLog.outcome: Confirmed a real gap rather than a baseline artifact. Filed issue #3459 with the evidence before writing code

workLog.phase: Extend the patterns and prove they are load-bearing
actions: Added two patterns scoped to the second segment, templates/agents/ and templates/platforms/, rather than a bare templates/ prefix

Chose the narrow scope because bare templates/ also names a Flask or Django render directory, a file-relative asset directory bundled inside a skill, and a substring of unrelated URLs, and all three resolve consumer-side
Extended the lookbehind character class with a hyphen so a URL segment like awesome-templates/agents/ does not match
Ran a ten-case table over the compiled patterns covering both new families, Windows separators, mixed case, and five negatives; all ten matched expectation
Negative control on the real validator: removed the marker from negotiation/SKILL.md and confirmed the validator reports DRIFT, then restored it and confirmed a clean run
workLog.outcome: Patterns verified to fire on the true positives and stay silent on the four negative shapes

actions: Added a vendor-portability marker to autoplan, negotiation, and security-review rather than deleting their references
Chose declaration over deletion because all three cite templates/ for provenance, which .claude/rules/canonical-source-mirror.md requires them to do
Regenerated the Copilot mirror with build/scripts/build_all.py and confirmed the marker survived generation in all three mirrored files
Bumped .claude and src/copilot-cli manifests to 0.6.133, above main's 0.6.131 and above the 0.6.132 claimed by open PR #3448
workLog.outcome: Validator stays at baseline 0 with the wider patterns in force, so the ratchet tightens without grandfathering anything

nextSteps: If a future skill takes a real runtime dependency on templates/, the marker is the wrong answer: the content has to move into the plugin root instead, per .claude/rules/plugin-self-containment.md
check_skill_portability.py is the script-file companion to this validator and was not examined for the same gap

endingCommit is the last content commit, 113c59808e, not the commit that records it. session-end/SKILL.md specifies git rev-parse --short HEAD, which no commit can satisfy for the commit writing the field
